status: static source implementation; not game verified

counting.method: Parsed the generated Go source trees for concrete DrainSourceCompute rule-ID call expressions, DrainInfo literals and SourceHostAmountID writes; counted TypeScript registry object keys and FlatDmg bridge call sites from checked-in registries and generated Go.
counting.interpretation: Counts are static unique source callsites/rule entries per lane, not runtime invocation frequencies; one source callsite can execute repeatedly. Dehya's six rules are included in the 19 and are not extra character entries. Nilou and generic Dendrocore FlatDmg rules are separate from the 19 drain rules.

sourceHostAmountIdCoverage.field: pkg/core/info/heal.go:25 SourceHostAmountID (shared DrainInfo/HealInfo source amount provenance field)
sourceHostAmountIdCoverage.attachmentScan: 14 character DrainInfo literals: 13 source-rule producers carry the corresponding SourceHostAmountID in the literal; Dehya manual self-hit attaches its selected manualIncoming/shield result ID immediately before Player.Drain. Avatar-generated player-hit DrainInfo computes PlayerDrainAmountID from incoming attack raw calculation and attaches it in the literal.
sourceHostAmountIdCoverage.dehyaHook: Incoming Dehya mitigation preserves beforeAmountID, uses it as a prior source for mitigation and after-mitigation, then overwrites both Amount and SourceHostAmountID. If an incoming source amount has no ID, native value remains and shared lineage starts at the first Dehya calculation.
sourceHostAmountIdCoverage.manualIncoming: pkg/core/sourcehost/manual_player_incoming.go:8-23 ManualPlayerIncoming prepares attack identity and records player-manual-incoming from rawDamage, optionally linked to tick raw/A1 component. Dehya sends that result to shield handling; PlayerDrainAmountID chooses last shield minimum result when shields ran, otherwise manual result ID. ManualPlayerApplied records application and restores previous attack ID.
sourceHostAmountIdCoverage.nativePath: pkg/core/sourcehost/bridge.go:343-361 PlayerDrain links AmountCalculationID/ComponentIDs only when SourceHostAmountID>0, then stores a DrainApplication; the shared HP-ratio formula remains downstream.
sourceHostAmountIdCoverage.foundMissingAttachments: No missing SourceHostAmountID attachment was found among the 14 authored DrainInfo literals, avatar forwarding literal, Dehya post-rewrite path, or the inspected SourceHost Drain endpoint in either generated tree. Zero IDs in non-sourcehost execution are the intentional disabled-bridge path.

laneDifferences: The registry rule IDs, DrainSourceCompute callsites, SourceHostAmountID writes, four FlatDmg callsites, and manual incoming route are present in both final trees. Paths and call line numbers match for the listed evidence; no lane-only producer was found.
limitations: This is static registry and generated-source evidence, not a game-mechanic verification.
Runtime multiplicity depends on callbacks/party loops and is not represented by callsite counts.
Zero-event rules preserve native event markers and do not establish self-damage.
Dehya retains the native comment that off-field direct character damage is a workaround/hack; no external verification is implied.
